title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
abstract: arXiv:2611.30835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence is never negative, yet PyTorch users have reported negative values for years, and the standard advice is to clamp them at zero. The sign is only the visible part of a silent failure. Many machine-learning applications compare nearby distributions, where conventional KL formulas lose accuracy. On 8.5 million inputs with certified references across 18 closed-form KL families and F.kl_div, we find widespread errors in values and gradients on CPU and GPU. Among scalar families in ordinary parameter ranges, over 85% of FP32 values have at least 1% relative error near KL 10^(-7) (FP16: 10^(-3)), and about 30% become negative at smaller divergences. More precision is not the cure: evaluated one precision higher, the same formulas still leave 7--51% of FP32 values significantly wrong for 22 of 23 configurations. Stable closed-form decompositions, compensated arithmetic, and analytic gradients remove over 97% o

translated_abstract: KL散度（Kullback–Leibler散度）永远不为负，然而PyTorch用户多年来一直报告出现负值，而标准的应对建议是将其截断为零。负值只是这一静默失效的可见部分。许多机器学习应用需要比较相近的分布，而传统的KL公式在这种情况下会失去精度。在跨越18个闭式KL散度族和F.kl_div函数的850万个带有认证参考值的输入上，我们发现CPU和GPU上的数值与梯度存在广泛的误差。在普通参数范围内的标量分布族中，当KL接近10^(-7)时，超过85%的FP32计算值至少存在1%的相对误差（FP16则为10^(-3)），而在更小的散度下约30%的计算值变为负数。提高计算精度并不能解决问题：即使以高一级的精度进行评估，同样的公式在23个配置中的22个仍然使7%至51%的FP32值出现显著错误。稳定的闭式分解、补偿运算以及解析梯度可以消除超过97%的误差。
tldr: 本文揭示了PyTorch中KL散度实现存在广泛的数值精度缺陷——负值只是表象，其根源在于传统公式在比较相近分布时产生大量数值与梯度误差，而稳定的闭式分解、补偿运算和解析梯度可消除超过97%的误差。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals widespread numerical accuracy failures in PyTorch's KL divergence implementations—negative outputs are merely the visible symptom of conventional formulas losing accuracy when comparing nearby distributions, while stable closed-form decompositions, compensated arithmetic, and analytic gradients eliminate over 97% of these errors.
